properties.description: A long-lived branch carries a live store's record (a new decision and an edit); meanwhile a PR squash-merges into main. A fold branch from the live record merges main with plain git: no conflict; squashed into main, the design equals a sequential replay of both; folding the same record again changes nothing. The fold the item layout makes possible without --merge/--merge-apply; the branch overlay of ver:an-overlay-folds-after-a-squash-merge is a separate, unbuilt capability.
properties.name: A live store's record, committed on a long-lived branch, folds into main with plain git after another PR squash-merged, exactly once
